accom_shared_hostel_dorm.evidenceText: On average, hostels in Barcelona cost around €15 per dorm bed per night. The same city comparison reports private rooms separately at €132 per night.
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.referencePeriod: Hostelz Barcelona city comparison with quiet-rest filter; result crawled last month before 2026-07-31; source period otherwise not stated
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.searchQuery: site:hostelz.com Barcelona Spain hostel dorm private room average price
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.reason: Accepted as an exact Barcelona city-level central dorm-bed statistic in EUR with one-adult bed basis. The result is a filtered Hostelz comparison rather than a two-traveller product value; filter context is retained in provenance.

accom_hostel_private_room.sourceTitle: Barcelona Average Hostel Prices | Budget Your Trip
accom_hostel_private_room.evidenceText: The source reports an average private-room price of $52 based on 106 hostels and guesthouses, but does not explicitly establish two-adult or two-guest occupancy.
accom_hostel_private_room.referencePeriod: Budget Your Trip Barcelona hostel comparison; result crawled last month before 2026-07-31; source period otherwise not stated
accom_hostel_private_room.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Barcelona Spain hostel dorm private room average price
accom_hostel_private_room.reason: Rejected under the strict private-room contract because occupancy is ambiguous. A source-default or unknown-occupancy private-room price cannot be upgraded to two adults/two guests; no private product value is substituted.
